essential_price_rules: Wave-b must retrace less than 61.8% of wave-a. Wave-c must move beyond the end of wave-a.
retracement_rule: Zigzags are sharp corrections that usually retrace a significant portion of the previous impulse.
trading_action: Wait for the 5-3-5 structure to complete. The end of wave-c offers a high-probability entry in the direction of the main trend.

essential_price_rules: Wave-c is extremely short, failing to move beyond the end of wave-a. Usually wave-c is 38.2% to 61.8% of wave-a.
trading_action: A truncated c-wave indicates extreme market exhaustion and powerful underlying momentum in the opposite direction. Prepare for a violent reversal.

essential_price_rules: Wave-c is more than 161.8% of wave-a. Whenever a c-wave is more than 161.8% of an a-wave, the probabilities greatly favor the assumed a-b-c is actually the 1-2-3 of a five segment Impulse pattern.
retracement_rule: After an Elongated Zigzag, the market should reverse and retrace more than 61.8% of the c-wave before the end of wave-c is violated.
trading_action: Do not blindly assume an impulse. Wait for the 61.8% retracement of wave-c to confirm it was actually an Elongated Zigzag before taking action.

essential_price_rules: Two or three standard corrections separated by an x-wave. The x-wave retraces less than 61.8% of the previous standard correction.
trading_action: This pattern prolongs the consolidation phase. Do not trade breakouts until the final standard correction (e.g., the second or third zigzag/flat) completes.

essential_price_rules: Two or three standard corrections separated by an x-wave. The x-wave retraces more than 161.8% (or at least >100%) of the previous standard correction, causing expanding price action.
trading_action: The market is exhibiting expanding volatility. It is extremely difficult to trade. Wait for a clear thrust indicating the end of the entire complex formation.
